recovery_procedure: Re-establish an authorized bootstrap identity through approved key references, verify repository/evidence manifests, rotate root references, and record policy-qualified independent security verification. If the identity reference is unavailable, remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL without assigning operator work.
rotation_procedure: Create replacement key reference, verify dependent encrypted material, switch trusted reference, revoke old key, and retain evidence.
revocation_procedure: Suspend affected identity or key reference immediately, revoke active grants/secret leases, rotate material, and reconcile audit evidence.
